fusions.name: Knuckle Drop
fusions.desc: You leap up to 5 tiles to your target and deal 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of where you land, knocking them 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Clinging Throttle
fusions.desc: A leaping grab at an enemy at or below 25% health up to 6 tiles away that deals 20 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the full 6 tiles, and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Branch Swing
fusions.desc: You swing 3 tiles forward, then move 30% faster for 6 seconds with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Cornered Brute
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
